Off by default. Android copies your data to your Google account, encrypted with your phone\'s lock code: neither Google nor Sommelle can read it. The old phone\'s code is needed to get it back. Turning this off does not delete a copy already sent.
Unavailable: set a screen lock first. Without it, Android does not encrypt the copy and Sommelle does not send it.
